answer: Tighten approvals: [F5] of sampled claims had no manager approval, which across the year suggests about [F7] claims paid without one.
exec_summary: The audit tested a sample of [F2] claims from [F1] paid.
[F5] had no manager approval and [F6] exceeded the policy limit.
If the sample holds, about [F7] claims were paid without approval last year.
situation: A company paying employee expense claims under an internal policy.
complication: Management suspects approvals are weak, and a sample confirms gaps.
key_question: Is the expense approval control working, and what should change?

titles.situation: Expense claims are paid in volume under a single policy.
titles.options: Two ways to close the approval gap.
titles.recommendation: Block payment of any claim without a recorded approval.
titles.roadmap: Fix the system control first, then review exceptions.
titles.kpis: Two measures show whether the control now works.
titles.risks: Stricter checks could slow genuine reimbursements.

figures.label: Sampled claims with no manager approval
Sampled claims over the policy limit

issue_tree.finding: The approval control fails often enough to matter.
points: [F5] of sampled claims had no manager approval.

hypotheses.text: Every paid claim has a manager approval.

issue_tree.so_what: The control needs a system block, not a reminder.

chart.title: Missing approvals are more common than limit breaches.

issue_tree.finding: Limit breaches are rarer but still present.
points: [F6] of sampled claims exceeded the policy limit.

hypotheses.text: Policy limits are enforced at payment.

issue_tree.so_what: Limit checks should run before payment, not after.

options.name: System approval block
options.description: Configure the expense tool to refuse payment without a recorded approval.

options.name: Monthly manual review
options.description: Have finance review a sample of claims every month.

recommendation.rationale: It prevents the failure behind [F5] of sampled claims instead of finding it afterwards.

actions: Configure the approval block in the expense tool.
Review claims paid without approval last year with managers.
Re-test a new sample to confirm the control works.

risks.mitigation: Confirm with a second sample before acting on individuals.
